title: 10 ns explicit-solvent MD of the predicted Shha signalling domain: the fold holds and flexibility tracks predictor confidence
evidence_kind: SIMULATED classical MD of a PREDICTED structure; not an observation

model.name: OpenMM 8.6.1 CUDA mixed precision, amber14 + TIP3P-FB, PME 1.0 nm, HBonds, LangevinMiddle 301 K, 2 fs, 0.15 M NaCl, seed 20261101
model.context: Start: the Boltz-2 ShhN model (model_0.cif). Minimise, 100 ps NVT, 200 ps NPT, 10 ns production NPT; CA frames every 10 ps. TWO independent replicas (seeds 20261101 and 777000). Run as a Nebius AI job on one H100; results read from the job log, which the service splits and can return out of order, so the summary and final frame are reassembled and checked (JSON parse, gzip) before use.

numerical_checks.name: CA RMSD from the equilibrated start
numerical_checks.result: first 1 ns mean 1.33 A, last 2 ns mean 4.19 A, max 4.79 A; last-2-ns drift -0.11 A/ns

numerical_checks.name: per-residue flexibility vs the predictor's own confidence
numerical_checks.result: Spearman rho -0.63 (p=1.9e-20) between CA RMSF and start-model pLDDT: low-confidence residues move most

numerical_checks.name: radius of gyration, first vs last frame
SECOND REPLICA (seed 777000), same correlation
numerical_checks.result: Spearman rho -0.60 (p=2.1e-18): the confidence-flexibility relation reproduces across seeds

numerical_checks.name: cross-replica agreement on which residues move
numerical_checks.result: Spearman rho 0.91 between the two replicas' per-residue RMSF (median ratio 1.11)

numerical_checks.name: convergence, honestly
numerical_checks.result: the replicas DISAGREE on drift: last-2-ns slope -0.11 vs +0.98 A/ns at similar RMSD (4.19 vs 4.17 A). 10 ns is NOT converged; only the ranking of mobile residues is stable

parameter_unknowns: Force-field and water-model error are not quantified here.
Protonation states are PDBFixer defaults at pH 7.
open_questions: Does a holo run with Zn2+/Ca2+ reduce the motion at the metal site?
What does the +0.98 A/ns drift in replica 2 settle to over hundreds of ns?
limitations: 10 ns per replica: far too short to sample conformational change (argon), and the two replicas disagree on whether the RMSD has settled.
The start is a prediction, so every number inherits that uncertainty.
does_not_establish: that the predicted fold is correct (MD stability is not accuracy)
a converged simulation: the two replicas disagree on drift
any equilibrium property, free energy or binding quantity from one 10 ns replica
Zn2+/Ca2+ site behaviour: this is an apo run with no ions bound
anything about fin size, Shh gradient range or flight
